items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jeannie and a friend of hers and mine came into Birdland at night, that I was there. I was introduced to Jeannie. What’s Steve’s last name?

ctx.x: I was at – was it? – the Birdland on 52nd, when they moved from the other place. I was there. Jeannie and a friend of hers and mine came into Birdland at night, that I was there. I was introduced to Jeannie. What’s Steve’s last name?
